answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a distinct human sponsor who signs a fresh attestation each epoch, like a falcon that only flies when its keeper releases it at dawn. The sponsor stakes their own reputation and a small bond, and can back only a handful of agents. A farm would need a real person willing to vouch for every fake, and that human cost climbs like a vine choking the whole operation - one honest agent needs one sponsor, a thousand fakes need a thousand people.
